overview.description: The AXS Knowledge Leaders ETF (KNO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is actively managed to invest in highly innovative companies from developed markets. KNO was launched on Jul 7, 2015 and is issued by AXS Investments.
